meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 安装了此技能后，Claude 可以创建、读取、修改和保存 AnnData 对象（单细胞分析的数据结构），支持 .h5ad、zarr 等格式，并进行子集选择、连接、转置等操作。
howto.when: 当用户需要处理单细胞数据，尤其是操作 .h5ad 文件或与 scanpy 等 scverse 工具集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个.h5ad文件并显示前几行数据。

say.text: 将两个实验批次的数据连接起来，添加批次标签。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can create, read, modify, and save AnnData objects (the data structure for single-cell analysis), supporting .h5ad, zarr formats, and performing subsetting, concatenation, transpose, etc.
howto.when_en: When the user needs to work with single-cell data, especially handling .h5ad files or integrating with scverse tools like scanpy.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file and show the first few rows.
say_en.note: Claude uses anndata to read and display data.
